question: If supreme custom arises in every rite, why determine all this?
premises: from japa through homa, each single rite grows its own supreme custom
yet the sequence was determined as taught
inference: Rite-customs flourish, but the taught determination still governs.
uncertainties: rudhi (custom) vs nirupita (determined) tension kept, not smoothed
plain_english: From japa through homa, though in each single rite supreme custom arises — nevertheless thus it is determined.
